question: Choose the correctly spelt word:
solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. Receive .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Receive"** is correctly spelt.
 
• The spelling rule for words like "Receive" is based on the famous mnemonic: **"I before E except after C."**
 
• Among the given options, only **"Receive"** follows the correct spelling rule and is an actual word used in English.

Correct spelling: ***Receive***.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Commonly Misspelled Words:**
 
 
• **Recieve:** Incorrect because it violates the "I before E except after C" rule.
 
• **Ricieve:** Incorrect as "Ci" is not a valid combination in English spelling for this word.
 
• **Receve:** Incorrect as it omits the "i" in the correct spelling.
 
 
 
• **Mnemonic for Spelling:** Use "I before E except after C" to remember the correct spelling of words like "Receive" and "Deceive."
